test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**innocent**" means lacking experience with the complexities and challenges of life.
 
• In the context of the passage, children are described as needing guidance because they can drift in any direction, implying their innocence and lack of worldly experience.
 
• The other options: "**mature**", "**crafty**", and "**guilty**" do not fit the context of children needing guidance due to their impressionable nature.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *It is the responsibility of parents and guardians to shape the future of a child as he is very **innocent**__ and can drift in any direction.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Mature:** means fully developed in the mental or emotional sense, which contradicts the depiction of children in the passage.
 
• **Crafty:** means clever at achieving one's aims through indirect or deceitful methods, which does not describe the naive nature of children mentioned.
 
• **Guilty:** means having committed a specified wrongdoing, which does not fit the context at all.
